patterns.description: No se encontraron cards de perspectiva de comprador (buyer) en el corpus de Round 1. El corpus documenta plataforma, sellers, y marketplace, pero no experiencias de compradores. SC-R1-059 documenta el impacto de reviews en la confianza del comprador desde la perspectiva de un seller; SC-R1-038 documenta política de no-refund en compras in-app que afecta compradores — ambas desde perspectiva de plataforma o seller, no del comprador mismo.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-059: Seller-authored blog: Gumroad rating system publicly visible; a single 1-star review degrades buyer trust (seller perspective on buyer behavior)

patterns.routing_rationale: The corpus covers platform policies, seller experiences, and marketplace structure. Buyer experience (purchase flow, download experience, support interaction, satisfaction) is absent. This limits inventory reading: patterns about fees, refunds, and discovery cannot be evaluated from the buyer side. For example, FRI-001 (mobile app fee friction) documents platform and seller side but not buyer impact of the 40% fee or the no-refund mobile policy.

patterns.description: No se encontraron cards que documenten el proceso post-venta desde la perspectiva del comprador: descarga de archivos, acceso a contenido, soporte post-compra. El corpus documenta el mecanismo de entrega desde la plataforma (SC-R1-022) y restricciones técnicas de descarga (SC-R1-031) pero no la experiencia del comprador al recibir y acceder al producto.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-022: Gumroad ToS: sellers must upload files in Gumroad-approved formats; Gumroad facilitates delivery upon purchase (platform-side delivery mechanism)

patterns.routing_rationale: Delivery mechanism is documented on platform side (SC-R1-022) but buyer experience of accessing purchased files is absent. This limits reading of the file size limits cards (SC-R1-031, SC-R1-071) which document technical constraints but not whether buyers encounter those constraints in practice. The 500MB 'Download all' button limit (SC-R1-031) has no documented buyer experience of that limitation.

patterns.description: No se encontraron cards de sellers en mercados no anglófonos o en geografías donde las restricciones de payout documentadas (SC-R1-024, SC-R1-028) serían aplicables. El corpus documenta la restricción de payout para sellers sin direct deposit ni PayPal pero no incluye ningún seller-actor card de esas geografías.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-024: Gumroad help center: no payout method available for sellers in countries without direct deposit or PayPal
signal_summaries.SC-R1-027: Gumroad help center: 160+ countries supported; payout method varies by country
signal_summaries.SC-R1-028: Gumroad help center: if PayPal unsupported in seller's country, Gumroad cannot pay them

patterns.routing_rationale: Platform cards document that a subset of sellers in certain countries cannot receive payouts. No seller card in the corpus documents this experience. This creates a one-sided view of the payout constraint: the policy is documented but its human impact is not. Limits reading of FRI-003 (rejected due to same-actor) and the payout policy cluster.

patterns.description: No se encontraron cards que documenten outcomes de sellers en rango intermedio en Round 1. Los seller outcome cards del corpus se concentran en extremos: outcomes muy altos ($61,411; $15,000; $65/día) o muy bajos/nulos ($139.96 en 3 años; $21 en semana; zero tráfico). No hay cards de sellers con ingresos intermedios moderados ($500-$5,000/mes).

signal_summaries.SC-R1-054: Seller: $65.15 in 4 hours; $50-200 organic daily revenue
signal_summaries.SC-R1-049: Seller: zero organic traffic with 35 listings
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller: zero organic views with 26 products

patterns.routing_rationale: Absence of intermediate outcome cases limits reading of the seller outcome asymmetry pattern (ASY-001, TC-001). Without mid-range cards, the distributional shape cannot be assessed: it is unknown whether the distribution is bimodal or simply top- and bottom-heavy due to source selection bias. This gap was noted in TC-001's what_is_missing field as a known limitation.
